summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed between print and print_exception): it joins str() of each object with sep and calls self.print once with style, highlight (default True), end, emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", and crop=False. Added the "Added Console.out" CHANGELOG bullet under Unreleased, a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after Logging, and tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus prefixed aspect tests; RenderHook added to the existing import line). Nothing was committed and no tests were run, per instructions, so the new tests are unverified. The riskiest assertion is the exact escape bytes in test_out_style, which mirrors test_print_style but was not traced.
